content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates must send their Updated Resume / CV along with educational qualification and experience details to the official email address: [email protected] Applications must also be submitted directly at the District Collector Office, Kallakurichi. Email Subject Line: Application for Technical Assistant - District Climate Change Mission, Kallakurichi

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must have obtained an Undergraduate Degree in any of the following departments: Ubirological/Biological Sciences (உயிரியல் அறிவியல்) Environmental Sciences (சுற்றுச்சூழல் அறிவியல்) Ecology (துூழலியல்) Forestry (வனவியல்) Wildlife (வனவிலங்கு அறிவியல்) Public Policy Similar / allied fields Additionally, candidates should possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English, and basic proficiency in Tamil and English. Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority, particularly in a Government Department / Government Office. Experience in Data Entry and Data Management. Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping, and documentation. Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint. Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements, and PowerPoint presentations. Experience in data compilation, tabulation, and office documentation. Good communication, coordination, and organisational skills. Ability to coordinate with Government Departments and stakeholders. Applicants must be a resident of Kallakurichi District and must not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Kallakurichi Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate DCCM activities with Government Departments and stakeholders. Assist in implementation and monitoring of climate change and environmental activities. Organise and support capacity-building programmes. Collect, compile, and maintain climate and environmental data. Prepare reports, official correspondence, statements, presentations, and documentation. Maintain official files, records, and Mission-related documents. Assist in conducting DCCM meetings, workshops, training, and awareness programmes. Document successful climate initiatives and district-level best practices. Undertake field visits related to District Climate Change Mission activities. Perform any other duties assigned by the Mission Director / District Climate Officer.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following stages in order: Scrutiny of Applications In-person Interview Typing Test A waiting list of 2-3 candidates may be maintained as per the DCCM guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of 19 months under Government sanction. Monthly remuneration is Rs. 22,000/- with provisions for official travel related to Department of Environment and Climate Change activities as per applicable Government norms. Candidates must be residents of Kallakurichi District. Applications must be sent with the correct subject line and required CV/resume along with educational and experience details. Applications can be submitted via email or directly at the District Collector Office, Kallakurichi.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Climate Change Mission, Kallakurichi (DCCM Kallakurichi).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy, or similar/allied fields along with basic typing skills in Tamil and English.

faq.answer: Candidates must not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post, and must be residents of Kallakurichi District.

faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 22,000/- per month along with Travel Head provisions for official journeys.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the DCCM Kallakurichi Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates can send their updated Resume or CV along with educational and experience details to [email protected] or submit them directly at the District Collector Office, Kallakurichi.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual engagement for a period of 19 months based on Government sanction.

faq.question: Q9. What subject line should be used when applying via email?
faq.answer: The email subject line should be: Application for Technical Assistant - District Climate Change Mission, Kallakurichi.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Scrutiny of Applications, In-person Interview, and Typing Test, with a 2-3 candidate waiting list maintained as per guidelines.
